body.note: The portfolio's copper anchor: the first year copper out-earned iron ore is the start of a re-rating, not the end. Copper now makes up more than half of EBITDA at near-record prices. Copper output is targeted to grow about 40% by FY35, and Jansen potash adds a new commodity from mid-CY27. Net debt of US$8.7bn is below target, supporting a high payout and a 3.7% fully franked yield. With depressed Iron Ore Markets currently weighing on group performance, a recovery in this segment could help support the next leg.
